name: PdxEntityGrid
description:
A CRUD surface over a data grid: the user creates, edits and deletes rows in a local optimistic copy,
and `pdx-create`, `pdx-update` and `pdx-delete` let the app persist them.

members.name: columns
members.description: Grid columns (ColumnDef[]). An edit/delete actions column is appended unless readonly.

members.name: schema
members.description: FormSchema for the create/edit drawer. Without it the CRUD affordances are hidden.

members.name: addLabel
members.description: The create button's text. Empty: the entity-grid.add component string, «New».

members.name: rowActions
members.description: Show the per-row edit/delete actions column.

members.name: bulkActions
members.description: Extra bulk actions (besides the built-in Delete).

members.name: confirmDelete
members.description:
Ask before deleting ("Delete Alice Johnson?", "Delete 3 records?"). `false` for an app that
confirms, or offers undo, in its pdx-delete handler: the rows go at once.

members.name: rowLabel
members.description:
The field that names a row in its action buttons and in the delete confirmation. Empty:
the first text column, else the id.

members.name: openCreate
members.description: Open the drawer on an empty record.

members.name: openEdit
members.description: Open the drawer on this row.

events.name: pdx-create
events.description: A record was created in the drawer. `clientId` names its optimistic row until the app's id replaces it.

events.name: pdx-update
events.description: A record was edited in the drawer.

events.name: pdx-delete
events.description: Rows were deleted: one from its row's button (with the row), or the selection from the bulk bar.

events.name: pdx-bulk
events.description: One of `bulkActions` was pressed, over the selection.

cssParts.name: toolbar
